segments.source: Our decision is about buying fit rather than a sensory score. The roaster direction of citrus, graham and cocoa may help you select a first bag, but origin, roast date, water, grind and brewing can change what you notice. If the first bag misses your preference, use that observation to guide the next purchase rather than treating published notes as a guarantee.

segments.source: The roaster gives a 1:17 drip starting ratio and a separate espresso preparation around 19.5 g. Check your actual basket capacity before copying that dose.
